request.question: Is appeal APL-2027-0038 admissible at screening (at least in part) under the AAR as amended?

options.description: true: The appeal meets the time limit and at least one ground is admissible, and no other admissibility bar applies.
false: The appeal is inadmissible (out of time, no admissible ground, or another bar in Sections 2-5).
